label: Wardens Homeland - Frostmarch Valley

biome.terrain: cold highland shelf: a dry stone valley closed at the south, scree slopes on both shoulders, a frozen creek along the west wall, a low ridgeline with the gate cut through it closing the north end
biome.climate: cold and thin, low pale sun, heavy distance fog
ground: packed snow in the lee of walls
biome.rock: cold grey granite with pale blue veining, squared by old tools
biome.vegetation: none above the treeline, sparse dark juniper scrub against the south wall
biome.water: a shallow frozen creek along the valley floor, glassy ice
biome.light: pale low sun from the south-east, hard shadow edges, blue bounce light
biome.architecture: oversized squared stone blocks, chunky, at most three materials per landmark (one stone, one metal, one trim)
biome.fog: steel blue haze, distance read dies past 90 m, landmarks resolve as flat silhouettes

landmarks.purpose: home claim, respawn hearth, quartermaster and the war-window board
forge: repair, re-plate and temper starter weapons and armour
blessing shrine: class buffs, healing water and the tier-1 respec
market: buy potions and plate, sell loot, read the bounty board
the last line: a guard barricade narrowing the road to the gate
the war gate: the only exit to the contested middle, shut outside war windows

notes: MIRROR: this map is the mirror of homeland_ashkin. Every position maps by x -> -x and z -> -z (a half turn about the map centre), so both starters learn one shape and meet in the middle on equal footing. The home basin is the -Z end; the gate and the only portal are the +Z end. On the Ashkin map the home is +Z and the gate is -Z. LAYOUT GRAMMAR (shared by both maps): keep at the closed end, road up the spine, a smithy spur on one shoulder, a shrine spur on the other, a market spur further up, a barricade choke, then the gate. LANDMARKS: six oversized masses, at most three materials each (squared stone, one metal, one trim), read as flat silhouettes in the blue haze. Gold trim is the only warm colour on the map and it marks the gate, the shrine and the market. LEVELS: nine open world camps, level 1 at the frozen shallows beside the keep up to level 20 at the crown rock; each camp is a spawn cluster in the open world, never an instance, and it respawns on its own timer (30 s at the low end, 90 s at the boss end). SIGHT LINES: the road is the only long view; from the keep the gate is 134 m away and around two bends, so it is never in frame; from the barricade the gate is 30 m away and fills the frame; the fog eats anything past 90 m. TRAVEL: 150 m straight line and 162 m of road from the keep forecourt to the portal, about 27 s at a 6 m/s run, 41 s on foot. THE PORTAL: the single exit at the north end of the road opens onto contested_middle, and the Wardens enter that map from its south side; the homeland sits south of the middle and the Ashkin homeland north of it, so the two valleys point at each other. This is the farm half of the war loop: level in the valley, then walk to the gate and take the middle.
